column1: > Every rule this layer's contract states, and what proves it. Full accounting,
> never full coverage: a rule no sequence of driver operations can detect says
> so here with its reason, and a rule nothing implements yet says that.
>   <tag>  <the rule>  <scenario ... | untestable: why | not built: why>
> abstraction-config/go/corpus_test.go reads the scenarios beside this file and
> compares the Go provider's transcript with the recorded .expected byte for byte.

column2: the nearer location wins: process over user over machine
a site location is reserved and absent
column3: untestable: an absent location answers nothing, so no operation tells "reserved" from "never thought of"

column2: every answer carries provenance per key: a location and a path, or environment, or default
column3: nothing user-file environment-over-user provenance-is-per-key off-carries-provenance malformed-is-said

column2: the path half of provenance names the file that answered
column3: untestable: a path is one machine's, so no transcript two machines compare can carry it; held by abstraction-config/go/config_test.go

column2: the machine location is read only when an administrator owns the file and its directory, and an untrusted file is ignored rather than obeyed
an ignored file is said on stderr, never silently
a machine file an administrator did own is read
column3: untestable: a driver running as an ordinary user cannot make a root- or Administrators-owned fixture, and the rule under test is what stops it reading its own

column2: a write to the machine location that no reader would trust is refused, and leaves nothing behind
column3: untestable: the corpus records reads; writes are held by abstraction-config/go/trust_test.go, which says UNPROVEN on stderr where the machine location is /etc

column2: a subscription reports the answer when it differs, from whichever process wrote it, and names its mechanism
column3: untestable: the notice is judged over wall time and across processes, which a transcript compared byte for byte cannot carry; held by abstraction-config/go/watch_test.go. The comparison it leaves to the client is CFG-W2, and that half a transcript does carry

column2: the stamp follows the answer, not the location that gave it
the environment is an override for the process location, and an empty variable is not one
a value taken from the environment is never observed to change
column3: untestable: an absence, and no sequence of calls can observe a notice that is never sent

column2: future raw fields survive conditional edits; typed unknown edits refuse and malformed known stored values are ignored with defaults
column3: untestable: this legacy transcript driver has no typed editor surface; held by go/typed_store_test.go and go/typed_diagnostics_test.go, including verbatim member preservation, bounded diagnostics and CAS revisions

column2: settings carry no secrets; native providers and settings clients need independent exact-key read grants
column3: untestable: this file driver carries no authenticated IPC peer; held by go/service/typed_test.go, facade/go/runtime/config_key_read_test.go and serve/runtime_config_typed_test.go

column2: trusted machine values lock catalogue lockable keys against user and process overrides
column3: untestable: an ordinary transcript driver cannot create administrator ownership; native policy and process overlay are held by go/typed_store_test.go and the existing trust owner tests

column2: typed catalogue values distinguish zero, unset and descriptor-admitted unlimited; all language overlays share the catalogue
column3: untestable: the file transcript has no typed value or process-overlay operations; held by go/typed_store_test.go and idl/gen/config_catalogue_corpus_test.go across all five bindings
